executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under heavy pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM and HBM are currently among the tightest segments. New capacity and improved yields can ease pressure, but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
